notes.title: Political Economy Update: Factions, Riots, and Power
notes.notes:
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3503190/AstroCore_Mining/"][/dynamiclink]

With the new Political Economy Update, Astrocore Mining goes beyond survival and resource extraction. As a middle manager in charge of a corporate colony, you face faction conflicts, worker riots, and interstellar diplomacy. 



Choose your ruling style such as democratic or authoritarian, and balance CEO pressure against worker survival. Every policy you enact, every quota you enforce, and every deal you strike determines whether your company rises as a capitalist powerhouse or collapses under chaos.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45545968/01c17e82188f645421db72ba6db619e0c1eb8a03.png"]
✦ New Features
Main Frame Building: The central hub where managers oversee all asteroid operations.

Manager Role: You control the fate of the colony, from strategy to survival.

Guards: Armed units defend against pirate raids. More guards can be recruited to secure the asteroid.

Pirate Raids: Pirates attack, stealing funds and killing anyone in their way.

Air Lock Building: Entry point for all ships docking at the asteroid.

Worker Riots: Unpaid workers revolt, spreading chaos across the colony.

Hospital Beds: Provide recovery areas where injured workers can heal.
